summary.text: Robin Harvey is a Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 10, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She served on the Baltimore County Board of Education, representing District 1, from December 1, 2022, to 2026, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Robin Harvey was elected to the Baltimore County Public Schools board, District 1, in 2022 as a nonpartisan candidate, defeating Cory Koons in the November general election with 70.4 percent of the vote.
In the 2026 Democratic primary for District 10's three House seats she finished second, with 23.4 percent of the vote.
